sasha: Heads-up — after pulling latest flash-attention/main in our runtime tests we see a ~20-30% tail-latency regression on 8k contexts. Reproducer in perf-ci, linking numbers below.
sasha: Quick snapshot: baseline (fa@v0.2.8) 99p latency 220ms, after upstream merge (main@524a1b) 99p latency 280ms. mean +15%.
sasha: Profiling shows extra kernel dispatches around KV read path, suspicious tensor stride changes. cc @mike @lee
ci-bot: New upstream commit merged to flash-attention: https://github.com/HazyResearch/flash-attention/commit/524a1bdc (changes qkv layout for better GPU memory coalescing)
mike: ugh. that commit was in review. could be layout vs our paged-KV assumptions. did we pin any ABI expectations in the runtime?
sasha: we assumed contiguous q/k shapes in paged attention KV cache code. The upstream change adds an axis reshape in the fused kernel which flips inner stride.
lee: Can you paste the minimal perf output?
sasha: paste:
```
# local run (8k ctx, bs=1)
fa@v0.2.8 -> p99 220ms, p95 88ms, mean 60ms
main@524a1b -> p99 280ms, p95 110ms, mean 71ms
trace shows +3 memcpy + extra cudaLaunch per layer
```
lee: That pattern (extra memcpy + cudaLaunch) smells like kernel now requiring a contiguous buffer. If our paged-KV produces non-contiguous views we get copies.
olga: Is this reproducible in small harness? If yes, we should add a regression test to catch in CI.
sasha: yes repro in local harness and perf-ci. I added a tiny script that toggles flattening.
sasha: quick workaround: force our runtime to call .contiguous() on KV pages before kernel. That removes extra memcpy in traces but adds memcopy cost earlier. net perf returns to ~230ms p99 so still slightly worse but acceptable as mitigation.
mike: For deploy we should pin flash-attention to the previous tag and open an issue + PR to FA with suggested change: make kernel accept strided input or expose no-copy path. I can draft upstream issue.
lee: Also check vLLM and xformers patches — they sometimes inject layout transforms. If vllm expects new layout and we pin FA, we may see mismatch.
sasha: Good call — I ran a quick diff: vLLM patch r123 modifies qkv concat ordering, but that only hits our hosted model when using vLLM option. For default runtime path it's only FA main.
olga: Action items: pin FA at v0.2.8 in our hosted image (olga), add regression test in perf-ci (sasha), open FA issue + minimal repro (mike), add hotfix contig in runtime as opt-in flag (lee).
ci-bot: Canary deployment started for image: ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:canary-20260317-9a2b
sasha: I'll attach the reproducer gist and perf traces to the GH issue. Gist: https://gist.github.com/sasha/abcdef123456
mike: Thx — once PR/issue posted ping #eng-runtime and I'll shepherd upstream. Also let's add a note to the rollout playbook: "if FA main causes extra cudaLaunchs in KV path, pin and escalate".
lee: Also adding a small smoke to our kernel-selection heuristic: prefer kernel variants that accept strided inputs for paged-KV workloads. Might be a quick wins to avoid future regressions.
sasha: ok I'll add the smoke test and link it in perf-ci. For visibility, tagging this thread with prod-impact:low latency:regression.
olga: thanks team, will coordinate the pin and canary hold until we confirm perf numbers. :thumbsup:
